content.title: Configure a workstation with valid boundary quantities and immediate price updates
content.intent: Prove a workstation configuration remains orderable across representative valid option combinations, the running unit price updates immediately as selections change, and the configuration can be added with the valid boundary quantities 1 and 500.
content.technique_notes: Used equivalence partitioning for processor/memory profile, storage, and operating system choices; used boundary value analysis on quantity via expand_bva over 1..500, which produced [0,1,2,499,500,501] and retained the valid in-range boundaries 1 and 500 for this outcome-identical path; used covering_array with strength=3 because money risk applies and no override was present, grouping the constrained processor-memory choices as cpu_memory_profile to respect the 64 GB compatibility rule while covering 3-way interactions across cpu_memory_profile × storage × os × quantity in 12 valid combinations.
